Name: Seasonal Leo Portrait
Author: StardewStardude
Description:
I made a winter portrait version using Archer810's Modder Assets for their mod, "Vanilla Style Leo Portrait".

I used Photoshop and Clip Studio Paint, as well as Notepad, to write instructions for the mod, which is in the .Rar folder, too.

If you don't want to read them, just put the files in that mod's folder, then move that to your mods in the internal files of Stardew straight into the folder called Mods.

If that doesn't work, search up Leo in your Mods, copy-paste them, then click replace, NOT Merge.
